correctness.rationale: The least-uncovered-vertex matching recursion is exhaustive and unique by induction, yielding 120 matchings. Any symmetric difference of two perfect matchings is a union of alternating cycles, so a single length-l cycle is the exact legal flip criterion. The cycle-first Python verifier enumerates 0,12,54 simple cycles of lengths 4,6,8, then every legal move. The independently implemented pair-first C++ verifier checks all 7140 unordered matching pairs for connected symmetric differences. Both compute the 0,192,414 edge counts; 6-cycle component partition (9 singles, three 18, one 57); full 8-cycle connectivity, radius 4, diameter 6, eccentricity histogram 72/42/6. Both executed successfully with hard assertions. No infinite inference is claimed.

originality.rationale: The published archived matching-count paper concerns lower bounds and asymptotic matching measures, not fixed-cycle transitions. The inspected alternating-cycle reconfiguration paper permits arbitrary cycle lengths, and the quadrilateral-flip paper permits length four; neither implies that the Nauru graph is connected by **only length-eight** alternating cycles with diameter six. An earlier exact Nauru 120-matching anti-forcing/two-factor census provides the baseline number of states but not the 13 hexagon components or sharp octagon distances. Searches under the graph aliases and equivalence to symmetric difference single cycles identified no statement dominating these exact structural assertions. The residual risk of unpublished or unindexed tabulations remains.
residual_risks: An equivalent exact octagon-flip census may exist under F(024)A, permutation-star or Nauru aliases in inaccessible or unindexed literature.
The current published search is not exhaustive; negative search results do not certify publication priority.

value.rationale: For the canonical 24-vertex edge-transitive cubic bipartite graph of girth six, the contrast between blocked quadrilateral moves, 13 hexagon components, and connected octagon moves isolates a sharp natural local-update threshold. The exact diameter six quantifies how efficiently all perfect matchings can be reached under only the first usable globally connecting even cycle size. These are structural dynamical features absent from the known 120-state count and complementary two-factor statistics, and they provide a reproducible benchmark for length-constrained matching reconfiguration without requiring an infinite-family result.
